item.description:
New

  • Automatic updates (Settings → Check for Updates).
  • Top processes: expand the CPU and Memory headers to see the heaviest processes.
  • High-usage notifications for CPU, memory, and power, toggleable in Settings.
  • Settings section with notifications and launch-at-login.
  • Wi-Fi network name and interface in the Network section.
  • JetBrains Mono across the UI.

Improved

  • Popover reworked into one scrollable vertical layout.
  • More resilient sampling: a failed read shows a banner with Retry.

Fixed

  • Memory process list was missing most processes.
  • Swap usage percentage when total swap is under 1 GB.
  • Invisible chart hover readout pill.
